title: Women, Work and Caregiving Through the Arc of Family Life
summary_en: Gender, work and caregiving are often woven together in family life in the United States. Most parents with children under 18 are employed. title: Men Are Experiencing More Job Growth Than Women in AI-Exposed Occupations
summary_en: Men’s employment grew faster than women’s in occupations most exposed to AI, a gap driven largely by workers without a bachelor’s degree.
